source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Long Pillar Locations (Bloodline Awakening)
source_excerpt:
The Bloodline Awakening quest in Phantom Blade Zero starts after you encounter the first Long Pillar. Inside each pillar, you will fight the Gold-Masked One , who is easily one of the hardest challenges you will face, especially early in the game. Although these fights are optional, they are tied to the Perfect Ending and reward valuable accessories and Soul Tempering Materials, making them worth completing as soon as you can, even if some encounters take a while.
There are five Long Pillars in total, and this guide lists the location of each one along with the rewards you receive for defeating the Gold-Masked One inside.
All Long Pillar Locations in Phantom Blade Zero
After acquiring the Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate Key , use it to access the eastern side of the region. Make your way to the Crane Bell, where you will find the Rusted Loong Key . Use this key to open the locked gate east of your location on the map. Head inside and explore the cave until you find an exit leading to the first Long Pillar.
After the Iron Fever boss fight, follow the main path until you reach a split with a Memory Flower on your right. From here, head right and use the Hunter's Chain Sickle to grapple across to the other side, where you will find the second Long Pillar.
After acquiring a boat, travel to the extreme eastern side of the region, where the Long Pillar is marked on the map. You will find a small island where you can interact with the pillar to start the fight.
Phantom Illusionist Ruins (Meigu Lake)
Find all four Acolyte Masks and interact with the Mirror to enter the Phantom Illusionist Ruins. From the third Bell, use the Dread Axe to break the barrier and proceed past it to find the Long Pillar.
After entering Mirage Estate through the Green Serpent House, follow the main story path until you reach the Covered Corridor Bell. Head forward from this Bell, then take the path on the right until you can look down and spot a grapple point. Use the Hunter's Chain Sickle to reach the other side and follow the path until you reach the final Long Pillar.
All Gold-Masked One Rewards in Phantom Blade Zero
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
Defeating the Gold-Masked One inside each Long Pillar rewards you with the following items:
Weeping Creek Valley: Counterstriker Bracers (Accessory)
Crimson Forest: Miraculous Scabbard (Accessory)
Meigu Lake: The Quenched Flaming Grip (Soul Tempering Material)
Phantom Illusionist Ruins (Meigu Lake): Chaos Iron Fragment I (Soul Tempering Material)
Mirage Estate (Pangzhen): Bastion of Mo Mask (Soul Tempering Material)
